   101	      D.sectionsMapTop B'

   103	          (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))

   113	    (relCover_sup C B' (fiberTwoCover pi))).injective

    11	/-!
    12	# Widened effectivity for fibrewise-regular sections
    13	
    14	This module is the R2 bridge used by admissible Abel coverage.  A section of a cocycle datum
    15	first cuts intrinsic local equations.  Fibrewise regularity is transported through the section
    16	ring of an arbitrary affine open; the resulting local-equation system is then certified using
    17	away-local arbitrary `AffCoverData` adaptations.  No widened cover piece is identified with one
    18	of the two auxiliary charts used to present the cocycle.

    44	/-- Multiplication-injectivity on a residue fibre is the pure-tensor nonzerodivisor
    45	condition for a component of a cocycle-datum section. -/
    46	theorem component_tmul_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors
    47	    (hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
    48	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
    49	    (j : D.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B) :
    50	    letI : Algebra B Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) :=
    51	      ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B (D.pieces j)).toAlgebra
    52	    (D.component s j ⊗ₜ[B] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    53	      Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ∈
    54	        nonZeroDivisors
    55	          (Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
    56	  letI : Algebra B Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) :=
    57	    ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B (D.pieces j)).toAlgebra
    58	  have hend : Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j) =
    59	      LinearMap.mulLeft B (D.component s j) := by
    60	    ext t
    61	    simp [Scheme.mulSectionEnd_apply]
    62	  have hinj := hfib j p
    63	  rw [hend, rTensor_mulLeft_eq_mulLeft_tmul p.asIdeal.ResidueField
    64	    (D.component s j)] at hinj
    65	  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff]
    66	  constructor
    67	  · intro z hz
    68	    apply hinj
    69	    rw [LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, mul_zero]
    70	    exact hz
    71	  · intro z hz
    72	    apply hinj
    73	    rw [LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, mul_zero, mul_comm]
    74	    exact hz

    78	theorem component_relAffSectionsMap_mem_nonZeroDivisors
    79	    (hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
    80	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField))

    82	    [IsScalarTower k B B'] (j : D.index) :

    84	      nonZeroDivisors Γ(relCurve C B', relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ D.pieces j) := by

    86	    ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B (D.pieces j)).toAlgebra
    87	  letI : Module.Flat B Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) :=
    88	    flat_sections_isAffineOpen C B (D.isAffineOpen_pieces j)
    89	  have hbase :=
    90	    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_forall_tmul_residueField
    91	      (fun p => D.component_tmul_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors s hfib j p) B'

    99	      (D.isAffineOpen_pieces j) (D.component s j)

   122	theorem germ_self_pullbackEqn_sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular
   123	    (hfib : ∀ (j : D.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum B), Function.Injective
   124	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField))

   177	/-- A fibrewise-regular local-equation system of constant fibre class degree `n` has an
   178	away-local widened certificate at every prime of its Noetherian base. -/
   179	theorem exists_away_certifiedAff_of_fibrewiseRegular_of_classDeg
   180	    (hreg : ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra R L]
   181	      [IsScalarTower k R L], ∀ z : relCurve C L,
   182	      ((relCurve C L).presheaf.germ
   183	        ((d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R L)).opens z) z
   184	        ((d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R L)).mem_opens z)).hom
   185	        (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn (relCurveMap C R L) d z) ∈
   186	          nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C L).presheaf.stalk z))
   187	    (hdeg : ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra R L]
   188	      [IsScalarTower k R L],
   189	      classDeg L (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C R L) d.picClass) = (n : ℤ))
   190	    (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :
   191	    ∃ r, r ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
   192	      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) :=
   193	        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away r) r
   194	      ∃ (Dr : AffCoverData C (Localization.Away r))
   195	        (A : AffAdaptation Dr
   196	          (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r))
   197	            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
   198	              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away r)) d))),
   199	        A.IsCertified n := by

   201	    Scheme.LocalEquations.fibre_supportLocus_finite_of_forall_self_aff
   202	      C R d p (fun z => hreg p.asIdeal.ResidueField z)
   203	  obtain ⟨r, hr, Dr, A, hsw⟩ :=
   204	    Scheme.LocalEquations.exists_away_affAdaptation_swallowedBy_of_finite_fibre
   205	      C R pi d p hfinite

   208	  have hfin : ∀ j, Module.Finite (Localization.Away r) (A.colength j) :=
   209	    A.forall_finite_colength_of_swallowedBy ⟨j0, hsub, hmiss⟩
   210	  have hproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective (Localization.Away r) (A.colength j) := fun j => by
   211	    haveI := hfin j

   224	    A.rankAtStalk_colength_eq_of_swallowedBy_of_pulled_degree

   123	-- The glued trivialization carries a large dependent family of section rings.
   124	-- A nonzero global section of a cocycle-glued line bundle on an integral scheme is
   125	-- nonzero in every nonempty trivializing piece.
   126	theorem component_ne_zero_of_global_ne_zero
   127	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C K)] (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C K pi)
   128	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule K D.pieces D.unit ⊤)) (hs : s ≠ 0)
   129	    (j : D.index) (hj : D.pieces j ≠ ⊥) : D.component s j ≠ 0 := by
   130	  intro hcomponent
   131	  apply hs
   132	  have hUj : ((D.pieces j : Set (relCurve C K))).Nonempty := by
   133	    rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty (D.pieces j : Set (relCurve C K)) with h | h
   134	    · exact (hj (by ext x; rw [h]; simp)).elim
   135	    · exact h
   136	  have hres : gluedRes K D.pieces D.unit (le_top : D.pieces j ≤ ⊤) s = 0 := by
   137	    apply (gluedTriv K D.isGluingCocycle j le_rfl).injective
   138	    rw [map_zero, gluedTriv_apply, gluedRes_coe]
   139	    simpa only [component, Scheme.resHom_resHom] using hcomponent
   140	  apply Subtype.ext
   141	  funext i
   142	  by_cases hi : D.pieces i = ⊥
   143	  · have hopen : ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces i = ⊥ := by rw [hi]; simp
   144	    letI : Subsingleton Γ(relCurve C K, ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces i) := hopen ▸ inferInstance
   145	    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
   146	  · have hUi : ((D.pieces i : Set (relCurve C K))).Nonempty := by
   147	      rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty (D.pieces i : Set (relCurve C K)) with h | h
   148	      · exact (hi (by ext x; rw [h]; simp)).elim
   149	      · exact h
   150	    have hUji : (((D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces i : (relCurve C K).Opens) :
   151	        Set (relCurve C K))).Nonempty := by
   152	      simpa only [Opens.coe_inf] using
   153	        nonempty_preirreducible_inter (D.pieces j).isOpen (D.pieces i).isOpen hUj hUi
   154	    letI : Nonempty ↥((D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces i : (relCurve C K).Opens) :
   155	        Set (relCurve C K)) := by
   156	      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hUji
   157	      exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩⟩
   158	    have hinj : Function.Injective ((relCurve C K).resHom
   159	        (show D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces i ≤ ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces i by simp)) :=
   160	      map_injective_of_isIntegral (H := this) (relCurve C K)
   161	        (homOfLE (show D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces i ≤ ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces i by simp))
   162	    apply hinj
   163	    have hval := congrArg (fun t => t.val i) hres
   164	    simpa only [gluedRes_coe, Pi.zero_apply, Submodule.coe_zero, map_zero] using hval

   166	/-- Every component of a nonzero global cocycle-glued section on an integral scheme is
   167	a nonzerodivisor, including the vacuous empty-piece case. -/
   168	theorem component_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_global_ne_zero
   169	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C K)] (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C K pi)
   170	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule K D.pieces D.unit ⊤)) (hs : s ≠ 0) (j : D.index) :
   171	    D.component s j ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(relCurve C K, D.pieces j) := by
   172	  by_cases hj : D.pieces j = ⊥
   173	  · letI : Subsingleton Γ(relCurve C K, D.pieces j) := hj ▸ inferInstance
   174	    rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right]
   175	    intro z _
   176	    exact Subsingleton.elim z 0
   177	  · have hUj : ((D.pieces j : Set (relCurve C K))).Nonempty := by
   178	      rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty (D.pieces j : Set (relCurve C K)) with h | h
   179	      · exact (hj (by ext x; rw [h]; simp)).elim
   180	      · exact h
   181	    let hnonempty : Nonempty {x : relCurve C K // x ∈ D.pieces j} := by
   182	      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hUj
   183	      exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩⟩
   184	    haveI : IsDomain Γ(relCurve C K, D.pieces j) :=
   185	      @IsIntegral.component_integral (relCurve C K) _ (D.pieces j) hnonempty
   186	    exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero
   187	      (D.component_ne_zero_of_global_ne_zero s hs j hj)

   202	        (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).pieces j) :=

   206	  have hvalue : e (D.component s j ⊗ₜ[B] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) =
   207	      (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).component
   208	        (D.sectionsMapTop p.asIdeal.ResidueField s) j := by
   209	    change D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieceTermBaseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField j
   210	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm B Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j)
   211	        p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   212	          (D.component s j ⊗ₜ[B] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField))) = _
   213	    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul,

   215	        p.asIdeal.ResidueField j (D.component s j),

   218	        (D.sectionsMapTop p.asIdeal.ResidueField s) j ∈

   222	      (D.sectionsMapTop p.asIdeal.ResidueField s) hs j
   223	  have himage : e (D.component s j ⊗ₜ[B] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) ∈
   224	      nonZeroDivisors Γ(relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField,
   225	        (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).pieces j) := by
   226	    rwa [hvalue]
   227	  have hback : e.symm (e (D.component s j ⊗ₜ[B]
   228	      (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField))) ∈
   229	      nonZeroDivisors (Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
   230	    rw [← MulEquivClass.map_nonZeroDivisors e.symm]
   231	    exact ⟨_, himage, rfl⟩
   232	  apply injective_rTensor_mulSectionEnd_of_tmul_mem_nonZeroDivisors B
   233	    (D.component s j) p

/-- On a pure tensor, datum H0 base change is the comparison of the corresponding
global cocycle-glued section. -/
theorem linearEquiv₀_datumH0BaseChange_one_tmul
    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi) (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1)
    (y : Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) :
    Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
        (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B' : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
        isTerminalTop (D.baseChange B').sheaf
        (D.datumH0BaseChange B' hH1 ((1 : B') ⊗ₜ[B] y)) =
      D.sectionsMapTop B'
        (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
          isTerminalTop D.sheaf y) := by
  let e := Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
    (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B' : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
    isTerminalTop (D.baseChange B').sheaf
  apply e.symm.injective
  rw [e.symm_apply_apply]
  apply ((D.baseChange B').pairData.h0Equiv
    (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C B' (fiberTwoCover pi))
    (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C B' (fiberTwoCover pi))
    (relCover_sup C B' (fiberTwoCover pi))).injective
  apply Subtype.ext
  unfold e
  rw [h0Equiv_val_datumH0BaseChange_one_tmul B' D hH1 y]
  rw [Scheme.TwoCoverPairData.h0Equiv_val]
  rw [Scheme.TwoCoverPairData.h0Equiv_val]
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, D.datumDomBaseChange_tmul B',
    D.termBaseChange₀_tmul B', D.termBaseChange₁_tmul B', one_smul]
  rw [one_smul]
  simp only
  apply Prod.ext
  · change D.sectionsMap B' (le_preimage_chart B' (fiberTwoCover pi).V₀)
        (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit
          (le_top : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₀ ≤ ⊤)
          (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
            isTerminalTop D.sheaf y)) =
      gluedRes B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit
        (le_top : (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₀ ≤ ⊤)
        (D.sectionsMapTop B'
          (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
            isTerminalTop D.sheaf y))
    convert
      (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap B'
        (le_top : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₀ ≤ ⊤)
        (by rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top])
        (le_preimage_chart B' (fiberTwoCover pi).V₀)
        (le_top : (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₀ ≤ ⊤)
        (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
          isTerminalTop D.sheaf y)).symm using 1
    rfl
  · change D.sectionsMap B' (le_preimage_chart B' (fiberTwoCover pi).V₁)
        (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit
          (le_top : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₁ ≤ ⊤)
          (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
            isTerminalTop D.sheaf y)) =
      gluedRes B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit
        (le_top : (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₁ ≤ ⊤)
        (D.sectionsMapTop B'
          (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
            (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
            isTerminalTop D.sheaf y))
    convert
      (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap B'
        (le_top : (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₁ ≤ ⊤)
        (by rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top])
        (le_preimage_chart B' (fiberTwoCover pi).V₁)
        (le_top : (relCover C B' (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₁ ≤ ⊤)
        (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
          isTerminalTop D.sheaf y)).symm using 1
    rfl
